item.stem:
Parth fills the three cells in the figure with the numbers shown. A cell is a supercell when its number is greater than each immediate neighbour.

One or more options may be correct. Which two claims correctly identify supercells in this row?

options.A: The middle cell $8$ is a supercell, because $8$ is greater than $3$ and greater than $5$.
options.B: The left cell $3$ is a supercell, because $3$ is the intended leftmost number.
options.C: The right cell $5$ is not a supercell, because $5$ is smaller than its neighbour $8$.
options.D: Calling a cell a supercell is what makes its neighbours smaller.
